rules.title: SIP must be enabled.
rules.fix_text: Boot into Recovery and run /usr/bin/csrutil enable. Enabling SIP can change how some developer tools behave.

ai.summary: System Integrity Protection must stay on so macOS can refuse unsigned kernel changes.
ai.caution: csrutil enable requires Recovery OS and a reboot.

rules.title: The macOS system must disable the NFS daemon.
rules.fix_text: Unload the NFS daemon if it is not required.

ai.summary: Turn the NFS service off unless the organisation actually shares files this way.
ai.caution: Disabling NFS will break hosts that still export shares.

rules.title: The ISSO must be interviewed about this control.
rules.fix_text: Document the decision with the ISSO.

ai.summary: A person has to ask the ISSO; there is no machine check.
